rationales: A single force is not the characteristic turning action of a steering wheel.
Net force means the vector sum of forces, not the turning effect illustrated here.
Turning a car’s steering wheel is an example of a couple producing rotation.
Momentum is not the turning action of a steering wheel.
An electric bulb converts electrical energy mainly into light and heat.
A photocell converts light energy into electrical energy.
An electric generator converts mechanical energy into electrical energy.
An electric cell converts chemical energy into electrical energy.
Kinetic energy is the energy a body has because it is moving.
Nuclear energy is stored in atomic nuclei, not defined by a body’s motion.
Chemical energy is stored in chemical bonds, not defined by a body’s motion.
Potential energy is stored energy associated with position or configuration.
Water boils at about 100°C at standard atmospheric pressure, not 98°C.
78°C is not the boiling point of water at standard atmospheric pressure.
Water’s boiling point is 100°C at standard atmospheric pressure.
90°C is below water’s boiling point at standard atmospheric pressure.
Nm is a unit of torque or work, not momentum.
kg m s⁻¹ is a unit of momentum.
N s is also a unit of momentum because 1 N s = 1 kg m s⁻¹.
N s⁻¹ is not a unit of momentum; it has units of force per time.
Speed is distance divided by time, not displacement divided by time.
Acceleration is change in velocity divided by time.
Velocity is displacement divided by time.
Displacement divided by time gives velocity, not displacement.
The coefficient of friction is frictional force divided by the normal reaction.
R/Fₛ is the reciprocal of the coefficient of friction.
P/W is not the defining ratio for the coefficient of friction.
Fₛ/W uses weight rather than the normal reaction in the general definition.
The weight is not 100 N because the Moon’s gravitational acceleration is 1.6 m s⁻².
Weight = mg = 100 kg × 1.6 m s⁻² = 160 N.
1000 N would correspond to 10 m s⁻², not the Moon’s stated gravity.
1600 N is ten times the weight calculated using the stated lunar gravity.
A force in a plane is resolved into two perpendicular components, not one.
Two perpendicular components represent a force in a plane along rectangular axes.
Three components are used for resolving a force in three-dimensional space, not the usual plane case.
Four components are not needed to resolve a force in a plane.
The water stored in a dam does not store electrical energy by itself.
Water stored at a height has gravitational potential energy.
Kinetic energy is associated with motion, rather than water stored at rest.
Nuclear energy is stored in atomic nuclei, not in the dam’s stored water.
15°C is far below normal human body temperature.
73°C is far above normal human body temperature.
37°F is about 2.8°C, not normal body temperature.
Normal human body temperature is approximately 37°C.
10⁴ N m⁻² is not equal to one pascal.
10 N m⁻² is ten pascals, not one pascal.
One pascal equals one newton per square metre.
10² N m⁻² is 100 pascals, not one pascal.
1/10 cm is 0.1 cm, larger than the usual digital caliper least count.
1/100 cm is the usual least count of a digital vernier caliper.
1/1000 cm is smaller than the usual digital caliper least count.
1/10000 cm is much smaller than the usual digital caliper least count.
The third equation of motion is v_f² = v_i² + 2aS.
V_f alone is not equal to v_i² + 2aS; the final velocity is squared.
Time squared does not appear in the third equation of motion.
Time alone does not equal v_i² + 2aS.
FₛR is a product, not the coefficient of friction.
The coefficient of friction is the frictional force divided by the normal reaction.
R/Fₛ is the reciprocal of the coefficient of friction.
FₛR² is not the defining ratio and has incorrect dimensions.
